0022600125.text: The Atlanta Hawks (2-1, 1st in the Southeast and 3rd in the East) are 2-0 on the road and enter their fourth game of the 2026-27 season on a one-game losing streak, while the Houston Rockets (3-0, 1st in the Southwest and 3rd in the West) are unbeaten and riding a three-game winning streak. Atlanta is missing Henri Veesaar (knee) and Mouhamed Gueye (foot fracture), and Houston is without Marcus Smart (forearm strain) and Steven Adams (calf strain). The Hawks trail 0-1 in the 2026-27 season series after a 121-114 loss in Atlanta on October 24, and they lost both meetings in the 2025-26 season (0-2).
